title: Prime-position route search on LP2-03
question: What does the pinned P20 prime-position split and 58-route search produce on its actual source page?
reader_question: Does the prime-position route give a reading?
summary: The strongest route has six source-style trigram hits; 57 of 199 complete rune-shuffle searches reach at least six.
finding: Pinned page_20 maps to LP2-03 with 217 runes, not the 646 claimed in the source comment. Its nonprime-position stream has 170 runes. The 11-column route leads the 58 executed routes with six source-style trigram hits, a score reached or exceeded by 57/199 complete shuffled searches. The original source reports ten routes under branch-specific filters but does not establish a readable passage.
limitations: The shuffle comparison is descriptive, not a cipher model. The source uses variable-width GP Runeglish, brief English trigram lists, and no validated full-passage criterion. Only source-retained routes passed an unmodified-script synthetic parity gate; all 58 saved manuscript routes have separate index-map reconstruction. Other pages, reading rules, languages and layouts are outside scope.
next_steps: Propose a route from independent page evidence and test a held-out passage under a fixed reading criterion.

scope.representation: Exact GP29 runes in Wulfic pages/page_20/runes.txt at commit bf89d3d, aligned to current LP2-03; source Runeglish output and committed Deor poem.
scope.procedure: Partition by prime zero-based rune position, take the 170-rune nonprime stream, choose the source's first maximal-IoC Caesar shift, and execute its 58 literal routes and branch-specific trigram screens. Retain the separate prime rune-index-value split as an audit, then compare whole-search maximums with 199 seeded full-page rune shuffles.
scope.parameters: One pinned source page; 29 Caesar shifts; 58 executed routes; 199 whole-search shuffles at seed 20261023.
scope.exclusions: No broader transposition family search, new word segmentation, other page alignment or output language, and no claim of plaintext from a trigram count.

review.kind: pinned source replay with independently reconstructed route outputs
review.reviewer: Pre-outcome planted route recovery and pinned-source retained-route parity; independent 58-route digest and one complete shuffled-search reconstruction

reproduction.environment: Python 3 and NumPy for the independent checker. Optional source-root checks and full rerun use a checkout of pinned Wulfic commit bf89d3d13aad2b8f2c95ab195cf1b092f250775c.

visuals.caption: The best manuscript route scores six hits; 57 of 199 complete searches on shuffled runes score at least six.
